Elon Musk says SpaceX has closed $40 billion in GPU debt, claims debt markets have shut off credit for AI data-center companies, and predicts that more than 200 neoclouds face 'death and consolidation'. The remarks, posted on October 21, read as Musk agreeing that the financing window for AI infrastructure has narrowed sharply - a claim that matches this week's broader reporting on tightening credit for GPU-backed borrowers, but one his own borrowing makes self-interested.
